{{Quote|There goes my speeder. Shame, it was ''brand new''.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Hunted (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.16|Hunted (comic story)}}</ref>}}
The '''CK-6 swoop bike''', also known as a '''Freeco bike''', was a type of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] used by [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault troopers]] in cold temperature environments. It bore similarities to the [[JR-4 swoop/Legends|JR-4 swoop]], another product by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] and had greater range and durability than the standard [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]]. The "Freeco" nickname was a contraction of "freezing cold", the condition in which the vehicle was designed to operate.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Freecobike.png|thumb|left|250px|CK-6 on Orto Plutonia]]
The large CK-6 swoop bike included two sets of landing gear for more secure operation on icy terrain. These [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles possessed an integrated windscreen to deflect the snow and air off their operational environment. Freeco bikes could operate when even the most intense blizzards kept [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] gunships grounded. However, without constant maintenance and care, even a night on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] could freeze a bike's systems solid.<ref name="db" />

==History==
[[File:Freeco_bike.png|thumb|right|300px|[[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|Clone cold assault troopers]] adjusting a CK-6 swoop.]]
The swoop was tested by a squad of [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault troopers]] stationed on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] shortly before the squad was wiped out by an unidentified snow creature. As of the time of their disappearance, the speeder did not test well, as it was prone to freezing up. It was later used by clone troopers during the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|Battle of Orto Plutonia]]. These speeders were barely a match for [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] warriors mounted on [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatches]].<ref name="trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref>
The swoop was also used by [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], and a squad of [[Devil Dogs]] during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]]. The swoop saw no combat however and were abandoned once their transportation capabilities proved irrelevant.

==Behind the scenes==
The "CK-6 swoop" designation was based on the previously established [[JR-4 swoop/Legends|JR-4 swoop]].<ref name="db" />

The design of the vehicle is based on a [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] Sith speeder concept art for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] by [[Doug Chiang]] from 1996.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Saga">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'' Disc Seven: Star Wars Archives: Episodes I-III</ref>

[[The LEGO Group]] released a set featuring a Freeco bike on [[December 28]], [[2009]]. It contains [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]]. [[Hasbro]] also released a deluxe pack containing a Freeco bike and an [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] action figure in 2009.
